# HunterX — AI-Assisted Vulnerability Discovery, Validation & Proof Engine

Full documentation index for HunterX. This file complements llms.txt with the
complete sitemap of the documentation site and product pages.

- Author / maintainer: Ahmed Awad (AKA NullC0d3)
- Repository: https://github.com/nullc0d30/HunterX
- Current version: 7.0.0 (released 2026-08-11)
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Language: Python 3.11+
- Platforms: Linux, macOS, Windows (Docker supported)
- Product site: https://nullc0d30.github.io/HunterX/
- Identity: HunterX is created and maintained by Ahmed Awad (AKA NullC0d3); repository https://github.com/nullc0d30/HunterX. An unrelated Python project also uses the name hunterx on PyPI.

## Responsible Use

HunterX is designed for use only against systems you own or are explicitly
authorized to test. Obtain appropriate authorization before testing any system
and comply with applicable laws and terms of service. The author is not
responsible for misuse.
